comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Obtained as a reward for completing the Indigenous North American Clothes Memorial Album. Contains recipes for the following:

Hunters Tunic - R12 sewing
Ingredients: Leather Cord x30 + Exquisite Dye x1 + Suede x2
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Leather Mantle - R12 sewing
Ingredients: Folk Costumes x30 + Fine Dye x1 + Suede x3
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Leather Tunic - R13 sewing / male-only
Ingredients: Natal Indigo x10 + Folk Costumes x15 + Suede x8
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Poncho Dress - R13 sewing / female-only
Ingredients: Natal Indigo x10 + Folk Costumes x15 + Leather Cord x40
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sash Tunic - R13 sewing
Ingredients: Natal Indigo x10 + Folk Costumes x40 + Embroidery Thread x50
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Fur Tunic - R13 sewing
Ingredients: Folk Costumes x40 + Eagle's Wings x20 + Fine Dye x3
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Warrior Feathers - R14 sewing
Ingredients: Folk Costumes x20 + Leather Cord x50 + Eagle's Wings x40
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
American Beads - R14 sewing / male-only
Ingredients: Folk Costumes x20 + Leather Cord x50 + Fine Ruby x2
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
American Beads - R14 sewing / female-only
Ingredients: Folk Costumes x40 + Leather Cord x50 + Fine Ruby x2

Further details may be found on their respective pages. Cheers.
